scope: Velocity-class and fold-parity gate only. This is not a branch chart, root enumeration, or returned-sample certificate.

selected_itinerary.reason: Use the generic transverse doubled four-arc itinerary first. Glancing separator events are reserved as fallback degeneracies.

intervals.description: First super-field leg after the first field-speed separator.
First apocenter or recapture sub-field leg.
Mirror super-field leg after the second recapture.
Final sub-field return leg, periodically identified with I0.

next_executable_packet.same_certified_domain_check: phi_cyc.json, mesh.json, causal_ledger.json, branch_chart.json, causal_preledger_interval_report.md, and seed_chart_interval_report.md must all use the same packet_id and the same packet identity tuple.
next_executable_packet.preledger_acceptance: Each mesh subblock must be certified as empty, simple_root, or fold_layer. split_required is a packet failure until the split is performed.
next_executable_packet.branch_chart_acceptance: Each simple branch must be authorized by exactly one simple_root preledger row; empty rows stay inactive with positive gaps; fold_layer rows are routed to the fold-event atlas and not to branch-sum formulas.
next_executable_packet.seed_report_acceptance: The seed-chart interval report first checks packet identity, preledger consumption, and branch-chart authorization, then reports strict seed margins and finite sensitivity constants.

limitations: Does not enumerate roots of |x(t)-x(s)| = c_f(t-s) on ordered arc pairs.
Does not prove positive Jacobian floors, inactive-root gaps, memory-depth bounds, or returned-history residuals.
If interval root enumeration changes the separator count or requires a glancing event, this itinerary gate must be rerun.
